display.purpose: Game title and shift-end score reveals. Two instances per screen maximum.

headline.purpose: Station names, dish names on tickets, overheat labels. The chalk-on-board weight.

title.purpose: Mode button labels, section headers, countdown digits.

body.purpose: Commands, descriptions, chat messages. All gameplay instruction text.

label.purpose: Progress bar text, ingredient names, reward amounts. Only below 18px when spatially constrained.

shadows.name: tactile-press
shadows.purpose: Primary button rest state. Collapses to 0 2px 0 on :active.

shadows.name: arcane-press
shadows.purpose: Adventure/PvP button rest. Same mechanics as tactile-press.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Order tickets floating above the dungeon floor.

shadows.name: modal-depth
shadows.purpose: Overlay panels hovering above the game layer.

shadows.name: inset-vignette
shadows.purpose: Side-shadow on wide split panels for spatial depth.

motion.name: ease-out-fast
motion.purpose: Default for state transitions: hover, active, color changes.

motion.name: ease-out-float
motion.purpose: Floating text feedback (money, cook completion, cool effect).

motion.name: duration-snap
motion.purpose: Instant feedback: button press, bar fill, progress tick.

motion.name: duration-float
motion.purpose: Floating text animations. Ease out, no bounce.

breakpoints.name: stream-min
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum width for full gameplay layout.

breakpoints.name: mobile-obs
breakpoints.purpose: Reference viewport for stream-viewer readability checks. Not a responsive breakpoint — used as a legibility audit target.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action: Free Play, Start, Confirm. Tactile press physics.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #f5ead8; background: #d87428; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 32px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #8e4e18; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #8e4e18; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: Options, Cancel, Back. Stone-surface, no press shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #a08870; background: #231e19; border: 1.5px solid #3c3228; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); line-height: 1; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #2b2520; border-color: #524538; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: #1e1b16; }

components.css: .ds-station { position: relative; background: rgba(35,30,25,0.85); border: 4px solid #3c3228; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px; min-width: 200px; } .ds-station--cool   { border-color: #4aa854; } .ds-station--warm   { border-color: #c4a020; } .ds-station--hot    { border-color: #e07030; } .ds-station--fire   { border-color: #c03830; } .ds-station__label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-station__emoji { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; } .ds-station__name { font-family: 'Lilita One', cursive; font-size: 18px; color: #f5ead8; flex: 1; } .ds-station__cap { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 16px; color: #a08870; } .ds-station__slot { position: relative; height: 32px; border-radius: 7px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-slot__bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); border-radius: 7px; } .ds-slot__fill { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; height: 100%; background: #d87428; border-radius: 7px; transition: width 0.1s linear; } .ds-slot__text { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px; gap: 8px; z-index: 2; } .ds-slot__user { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-slot__item { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); flex: 1; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); } .ds-slot__time { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #f5ead8; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Channel name input, local chat input. A slot cut into stone.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field__label { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #7858cc; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { background: #1e1a14; border: 1.5px solid #3c3228; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; color: #f5ead8; font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4e4038; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #d87428; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview:
This is a cooking game played in a dungeon. The visual language lives at the intersection of a torch-lit adventurer's camp kitchen and a Jackbox party screen: dark cave stone behind everything, warm fire-orange commanding every action, parchment-colored text that reads from across a Twitch stream on a phone.

The palette draws from dungeon ecology: dark warm stone for cave walls, amber for cook-fires, vivid green for fresh monster herbs, purple for alchemical vials. These are not decorative choices — they map to game states. Torch-orange is action and heat. Verdure green is success. Signal red is danger and overheat. Dungeon gold is reward.

This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS dashboard (white card surfaces, muted blue CTAs) and the streaming overlay aesthetic (neon on black, OBS-style glowing widget borders). The game has its own visual world.
keyCharacteristics: Dark warm dungeon stone as the base layer; all surfaces warm-tinted, never cold grey
Broadcast-first scale: 18px minimum for all text, key game elements 22-54px
Full palette: torch-flame (primary action), verdure (success), arcane (magic/adventure), dungeon-gold (reward)
Tactile press physics on buttons: hard bottom shadow that collapses on active
Order tickets as physical parchment artifacts with perforated edges
Floating feedback text is the primary animation language

rules.name: The Dungeon Fire Rule
rules.body: Torch Flame (#d87428) is the sole primary action color. One fire color, one meaning.

rules.name: The Warm Stone Rule
rules.body: Every neutral surface is tinted toward amber. Cold grey is prohibited.

rules.name: The Gold Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Dungeon Gold (#c4a020) appears only on money values and reward feedback. Not decorative.

rules.name: The Broadcast Scale Rule
rules.body: Base font size is 18px, non-negotiable. The game is watched at mobile-phone scale on streams.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: No ambient box-shadow on static containers. Tonal contrast handles depth. Shadows for button press and overlays only.

dos: Do use Torch Flame (#d87428) for every primary interactive action.
Do size all visible text at 18px minimum.
Do apply the tactile press shadow (0 4px 0) on every primary button.
Do treat order tickets as physical parchment objects: perforated tears, punch holes, aged paper colors.
Do use tonal contrast to convey surface elevation — shadows only for overlays and button press.
Do make the heat border the primary station state indicator.
Do keep broadcast scale in mind: readable on a 375px phone watching a stream.
donts: Don't use #ffffff or #000000 for any surface or text.
Don't make it look like a SaaS dashboard: no white card grids, no muted blue actions.
Don't make it look like a streaming overlay: no neon on black, no OBS widget borders.
Don't use border-left stripes as status accents on cards.
Don't use Dungeon Gold decoratively — only on money values and rewards.
Don't use Twitch Purple outside of Twitch integration surfaces.
Don't make it cute or pastel. The kitchen has weight.
